name: CocoSat24
description: # Dataset: CocoSat24 Benchmark Set 24 conjugated organic core-level satellite spectraThis dataset contains supporting data for the article: J. Kockläuner, M. Shaker, M. Muth, S. Steinbach, C. Oleszak, O. Lytken, H.-P. Steinrück, D. Golze, Decoding Shake-up Satellites in XPS through Large-Scale ab initio Simulations: Spectral Signatures of Ring Fusion in Porphyrins, arXiv preprint arXiv:2509.26057 (2025). The benchmark set and all computational details are described in the paper and its Supporting Information (SI),sections S1–S3. Equation, table and figure numbers in the README files refer to the paper and the SI. CocoSat24 is a benchmark set of 24 experimental core-level shake-up spectra (8 C 1s, 7 N 1s, 9 O 1s) of 23 conjugatedorganic molecules with up to 40 atoms. For every core level, the set provides the experimental reference value of thesatellite splitting together with theoretical spectra computed with GW+C and ECH-TDDFT.
